sources.title: City of Kansas City, Missouri, City Issued Permits (Open Data KC dataset w8jz-wjgn): all permits on main parcel 97291, 3420/3500 N Arlington Ave (Edged Energy KC Data Center)
sources.attribution: City of Kansas City, Missouri (Open Data KC)
sources.summary: The city's issued-permits dataset returns 57 permits on main parcel 97291 at 3420 and 3500 N Arlington Ave, Kansas City, MO 64161 (Clay district). Certificate of Occupancy (Commercial) CICO-2026-00896 for project 'Edged Energy KC Data Center' at 3500 N Arlington Ave was applied for on 27 August 2026 and issued on 4 September 2026. The two new-building permits for the data center, CPBC-2023-00845 and CPBC-2023-01041 (work class New, issued 21 September and 22 November 2023), were finaled on 27 and 28 August 2026; the standby-generator and critical mechanical systems permit CPBC-2024-00874 was finaled on 27 August 2026; the grading permit CPBC-2023-00705 on 1 September 2026; and temporary certificate of occupancy CITO-2024-00455 (issued 10 December 2024) was closed on 27 August 2026. A 2025 renovation permit (CPBC-2025-00915) and 2025-2026 electrical, fire-alarm, fire-protection and mechanical permits for the data center were finaled between 9 and 16 September 2026. Separately, an 'Edged Energy KC Building Addition' (work class Addition, CPBC-2026-01070, applied 16 October 2026) is 'Ready For Issuance', not issued; its special-inspection permits were issued in May and July 2026.
sources.date_semantics: The status observation is the issue date of certificate of occupancy CICO-2026-00896, 4 September 2026 (issue_date 2026-09-04T14:53:20). published_at is a lower bound for the captured dataset version: the dataset metadata captured the same day (us-midwest-plains-p2-kcmo-issued-permits-metadata) give rowsUpdatedAt 2026-10-22T06:04:06Z; an identical response (same SHA-256) was captured on 23 October 2026. Completion is scoped to the building works certified by the occupancy certificate; it does not establish the opening date (the building was occupied under a temporary certificate from December 2024), operation, IT load or customers.
sources.personal_data_note: Permit rows carry no applicant, contractor or contact fields; no personal data are copied.

sources.title: TierPoint: St. Louis - Olive Data Center page (version modified 3 September 2026)
sources.summary: TierPoint's St. Louis - Olive page says 'This data center is the most energy-efficient and innovative data center and colocation facility in St. Louis' and that 'The TierPoint St. Louis data center on Olive is interconnected with 10G wave to other TierPoint data centers in the region'. It gives 'St. Louis - Olive (SLO) 1111 Olive Street St. Louis, MO 63101' with 124,000+ total square feet, 11,000+ square feet of raised floor, cabinets and cages, 1,100+ square feet of business-continuity seating, N+1 power distribution, two 2 MW redundant generators with at least 48 hours of runtime, a carrier-neutral facility, 24x7x365 on-site security and 24x7 remote-hands support. These present-tense statements describe a facility in service.
sources.date_semantics: Structured data give datePublished 2022-05-13 and dateModified 2026-09-03T06:48:15Z, matching the page-sitemap lastmod. The modification is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 11 August 2026 (us-midwest-plains-p2-tierpoint-slo-page-ia-20260811; dateModified 2024-07-31), whose facility section is identical apart from the absent sustainability-report banner, and above by the Internet Archive copy of 7 October 2026 (us-midwest-plains-p2-tierpoint-slo-page-ia-20261007; dateModified 2026-09-03) and this live capture of 26 October 2026. The edit was part of a portfolio-wide update on the same morning (the TierPoint Tulsa and Little Rock pages already in the Atlas carry the same day). published_at records the modification day and is used as a publication-normalised operating observation on 3 September 2026, not an opening or inspection date. Generator ratings are not IT load.
